title: New SCIM Connector Ticket Template
description: Machine-parseable contract for the YAML front-matter of a 'New SCIM Connector' Linear ticket. The orchestrator parses the ticket body, extracts the YAML block, validates against this schema before dispatching the agent. Schema violations = hard reject with a comment on the ticket.

customer_app_name.description: Display name of the customer's application (e.g. 'AcmeHR').

customer_slug.description: Lowercase hyphenated slug; used in repo paths, file names, and branch names.

auth_method.description: How the generated SCIM server authenticates to the customer's API. 'oauth_cc' = OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant.

auth_credential_location.description: Where the generated server reads its credential from at boot.

auth_credential_env_var.description: Env var name the server reads the credential from. Must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.

base_url.description: Canonical base URL for the customer's API. Must be https://.

environments.description: Map of environment name to base URL. Typical: dev/staging/prod.

user_model_source.description: Which pattern from docs/attribute-mapping-patterns.md applies. 'custom_db' means the agent generates a bespoke mapping.

user_model_sample_url.description: Link to source API docs or a sample user response. Optional if the ticket body pastes a full sample.

required_ops.description: Which SCIM operations the generated server MUST implement. Groups-family fields default to false; set true when the customer uses group push.

lifecycle_policy.description: What 'deprovision' means for this customer. Drives both DELETE handler and PATCH-active-false handler behavior.

deactivation_attribute_clearing.description: SCIM attribute paths to clear on active=false. Empty = retain all.

pii_retention_days.description: Days to retain PII. null = indefinite.

audit_retention_required.description: If true, server maintains a separate immutable audit log.

target_okta_tenant.description: Target Okta tenant URL. For hackathon: one of the two demo tenants. Post-hackathon: real customer tenant.

terraform_workspace.description: Terraform workspace. Enforces staging→prod promotion gate (BLAST-RADIUS LAW).

preprod_verified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp set by the pre-prod verify gate on pass. Null on ticket creation. Pipeline-written only — manual writes are a tampering signal.

preprod_manifest_sha.description: SHA-256 of the signed Promotion Manifest. Set at approval time (see docs/promotion-flow.md §4). Null until approved. Consumed on first prod apply.

approver_github_username.description: GitHub username of the human who approved prod promotion. Must be non-null for prod apply to proceed. Null on staging tickets.

promoted_to_prod_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp written by the prod apply step on success. Non-null means the ticket reached prod.

promotion_gate.description: Gate state for the pre-prod → prod promotion flow (docs/promotion-flow.md). All fields null on ticket creation; written by pipeline only. PR diffs that transition anything other than null → value are a tampering signal.
